main.description: A post. Record key: {fk}-{tid} with fk = fk(forum). Core rules: title is required unless the effective kind is quickTake; body is required for quickTake; link is required for kind link; excerpt is required when body uses textBlob.

forum.description: at-uri of the forum declaration. Fixed after creation.

kind.description: Post kind. An unknown value is read as article.

title.description: Title, plain text. Ignored for quickTake.

body.description: Post body. MAY spill to textBlob.

excerpt.description: Plain-text LFM/1 excerpt of the body; read only when body uses textBlob.

link.description: Link card; required for kind link, ignored otherwise.

tags.description: The author's own tag slugs (set semantics).

labels.description: Self-labels, for example sexual, nudity, porn or graphic-media.

createdAt.description: Set once at creation by the writer's clock; never changed.
